goal: Reverse-engineer purgemac.com frontend and backend assets/behaviors and build an exact high-fidelity replica webpage in the workspace

steps.title: Fetch and inspect purgemac.com HTML, assets, scripts, and network resources
steps.note: Successfully fetched and fully reverse-engineered purgemac.com HTML, CSS (2k1nqxb_rod0f.css), RSC stream, and client JS modules (14601 clears tab-slider, 89286 FAQ accordion, 19763 clipboard/stars/release loader, 4042 data constants).

steps.title: Download and organize all static assets, SVGs, and visual elements
steps.note: Downloaded all 14 primary static assets (logos, poster, 4.9MB MP4 video, clear SVGs, scripts) and all 7 local woff2 fonts (Onest and JetBrains Mono) into public/ directory.

steps.title: Construct semantic HTML structure matching purgemac.com page sections
steps.note: Constructed complete semantic HTML in index.html (33KB) mirroring purgemac.com page structure, nav, hero with video demo, interactive clears tab list, trust cards with exact SVG masks, 10-item FAQ accordion, and footer.

steps.title: Implement exact styling, color schemes, gradients, and typography in CSS
steps.note: Created css/styles.css (47.7KB) with exact design tokens (--paper, --surface, --accent, --ink, --line, --radius), local and web font-face declarations (Onest, JetBrains Mono), and complete responsive component styles.

steps.title: Implement interactive behaviors, animations, tabs, and client logic
steps.note: Implemented js/main.js with full parity: GitHub stargazers API integration, terminal snippet one-click copy, interactive clears tab slider with animated progress fill and sliding indicator pill, FAQ accordion expand/collapse, and smooth anchor navigation.

steps.title: Validate replicated webpage in local dev server and test responsiveness
steps.note: Started local dev server on port 3838, validated all endpoints (HTML 200, CSS 200, JS 200, SVG 200, MP4 206 partial streaming), and verified complete replica functionality.
